    public void onSaveSearch(String searchName, String searchTerms) {\n            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(searchName)) {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n private void filterByTag(List<String> selectedTags, int option) {\n        //TODO: Duplication between here and CustomStudyDialog:customStudyFromTags\n        mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n        String tags = selectedTags.toString();\n        mSearchView.setQueryHint(getResources().getString(R.string.card_browser_tags_shown,\n                tags.substring(1, tags.length() - 1)));\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        switch (option) {\n            case 1:\n                sb.append("is:new ");\n                break;\n            case 2:\n                sb.append("is:due ");\n                break;\n            default:\n                // Logging here might be appropriate : )\n                break;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        for (String tag : selectedTags) {\n            if (i != 0) {\n                sb.append("or ");\n            } else {\n                sb.append("("); // Only if we really have selected tags\n            }\n            sb.append("tag:").append(tag).append(" ");\n            i++;\n        }\n        if (i > 0) {\n            sb.append(")"); // Only if we added anything to the tag list\n        }\n        mSearchTerms = sb.toString();\n        searchCards();\n    }\n\n\n    private abstract class ListenerWithProgressBar extends CollectionTask.TaskListener {\n        @Override\n        public void null;\n\n        public ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse(String timber) {\n            this.timber = timber;\n        }\n\n        public ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse() {\n\t\t}\n\n        public void onPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result) {\n            if (timber != null) {\n                Timber.d(timber);\n            }\n            if (result.getBoolean()) {\n                actualPostExecute(result);\n            } else {\n                closeCardBrowser(DeckPicker.RESULT_DB_ERROR);\n            }\n        }\n\n        protected abstract void actualPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param cards Cards that were changed\n     * @param updatedCardTags Mapping note id -> updated tags\n     */\n    private void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ?    private void bindView(final int position, final View v) {\n            // Draw the content in the columns\n            View[] columns = (View[]) v.getTag();\n            final Map<String, String>          final CheckBox checkBox = (CheckBox) v.findViewById(R.id.card_checkbox);\n            // if in multi-select mode, be sure to show the checkboxes\n            if(mInMultiSelectMode) {\n checkBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);\n            }\n            // change bg color on check changed\n            checkBox.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n                @Override\n                public void onClick(View view) {\n                    onCheck(position, v);\n                }\n            });\n        }\n\n        private void setFont(TextView v) {\n            // Set }\n            // do nothing when pref is 100% and apply scaling only once\n            if (mFontSizeScalePcent != 100 && Math.abs(mOriginalTextSize - currentSize) < 0.1) {\n                // getTextSize returns value in absolute PX so use that in the setter\n                v.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_PX, mOriginalTextSize * (mFontSizeScalePcent / 100.0f));\n            }\n\n            if (mCustomTypeface != null) {\n                v.setTypeface(mCustomTypeface);\n            }\n        }\n\n        /**\n         * Get the background color of items in the card list based on }\n\n\n        public void setFromMapping(String[] from) {\n            mFromKeys = from;\n            notifyDataSetChanged();\n        }\n\n\n        public String[] getFromMapping() {\n private void filterByTag(List<String> selectedTags, int option) {\n        //TODO: Duplication between here and CustomStudyDialog:customStudyFromTags\n        mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n sb.append("is:due ");\n                break;\n            default:\n                // Logging here might be appropriate : )\n                break;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        for }\n            sb.append("tag:").append(tag).append(" ");\n            i++;\n        }\n        if (i > 0) {\n            sb.append(")"); // Only if we added anything to the tag list\n        }\n void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view.     public void onSaveSearch(String searchName, String searchTerms) {\n            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(searchName)) {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n                        getString(R.string.card_browser_list_my_searches_new_search_error_empty_name), true);\n                return;\n            }\n            JSONObject savedFiltersObj = getCol().getConf().optJSONObject("savedFilters");\n            boolean should_save = false;\n            if (savedFiltersObj == null) {\n                savedFiltersObj = new JSONObject();\n                savedFiltersObj.put(searchName, searchTerms);\n                should_save = true;\n            } else if (!savedFiltersObj.has(searchName)) {\n                savedFiltersObj.put(searchName, searchTerms);\n                should_save = true;\n            } else {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n                                        getString(R.string.card_browser_list_my_searches_new_search_error_dup), true);\n            }\n            if (should_save) {\n                getCol().getConf().put("savedFilters", private void onSearch() {\n        mSearchTerms = mSearchView.getQuery().toString();\n        if (mSearchTerms.length() == 0) {\n            mSearchView.setQueryHint(getResources().getString(R.string.downloaddeck_search));\n        }\n        searchCards();\n    }\n\n    private long[] getSelectedCardIds() {\n        //copy to array to ensure threadsafe iteration\n        Integer[] checkedPositions = mCheckedCardPositions.toArray(new Integer[0]);\n        //copy the reference: the list can be replaced by an async operation while we iterate\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = getCards();\n        long[] ids = new long[checkedPositions.length];\n        int count = 0;\n        for (int cardPosition : checkedPositions) {\n            //#6112: A checked position refers to the card list which was displayed when the card was checked.\n            //If the list was reloaded (or cleared) in the meantime, the position may no longer be valid.\n            if (cardPosition < 0 || cardPosition >= cards.size()) {\n                Timber.w("Attempted to access card at invalid position: %d (%d cards)", cardPosition, cards.size());\n                continue;\n            }\n            String cardId = cards.get(cardPosition).get(ID);\n            if (cardId == null) {\n                Timber.w("No card id at position: %d", cardPosition);\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids[count++] = Long.parseLong(cardId);\n        }\n        //the array may have been oversized if some positions were stale\n        if (count != ids.length) {\n            ids = Arrays.copyOf(ids, count);\n        }\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @return Whether the currently selected cards all belong to one (and only one) note.\n     * Used to determine whether the note can be edited: editing only affects a single note (#6112),\n     * so we must not offer the option when cards of multiple notes are selected.\n     */\n    private boolean hasSelectedSingleNoteId() {\n        long[] selectedCardIds = getSelectedCardIds();\n        if (selectedCardIds.length == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (selectedCardIds.length == 1) {\n            //one card is always exactly one note: no need to hit the database\n            return true;\n        }\n        //Heuristic to skip a potentially large query\n        if (selectedCardIds.length > 50) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (!colIsOpen()) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        try {\n            //Note: the "note" column of the browser contains the note type name, not the note id,\n            //so the selected note ids have to be obtained from the collection.\n            int noteCount = getCol().getDb().queryScalar(\n                    "select count(distinct nid) from cards where id in " + Utils.ids2str(selectedCardIds));\n            return noteCount == 1;\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Timber.w(e, "Failed to determine the number of selected notes");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    void changeDeck(int deckPosition) {\n        long[] ids = getSelectedCardIds();\n\n        JSONObject selectedDeck = getValidDecksForChangeDeck().get(deckPosition);\n\n        try {\n            //#5932 - can\'t be dynamic\n            if (Decks.isDynamic(selectedDeck)) {\n                Timber.w("Attempted to change cards to dynamic deck. Cancelling operation.");\n                displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n                return;\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n            Timber.e(e);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        mNewDid = selectedDeck.getLong(ID);\n\n        Timber.i("Changing selected cards to deck: %d", mNewDid);\n\n        if (ids.length == 0) {\n            endMultiSelectMode();\n            mCardsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (CardUtils.isIn(ids, getReviewerCardId())) {\n            mReloadRequired = true;\n        }\n\n        executeChangeCollectionTask(ids, mNewDid);\n    }\n\n\n    private void displayCouldNotChangeDeck() {\n        UIUtils.showThemedToast(this, getString(R.string.card_browser_deck_change_error), true);\n    }\n\n\n    private Long getLastDeckId() {\n        SharedPreferences state = getSharedPreferences(PERSISTENT_STATE_FILE,0);\n        if private void filterByTag(List<String> selectedTags, int option) {\n        //TODO: Duplication between here and CustomStudyDialog:customStudyFromTags\n        mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n        String tags = selectedTags.toString();\n        mSearchView.setQueryHint(getResources().getString(R.string.card_browser_tags_shown,\n                tags.substring(1, tags.length() - 1)));\n sb.append("is:due ");\n                break;\n            default:\n                // Logging here might be appropriate : )\n                break;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        for (String tag : selectedTags) {\n            if (i != 0) {\n                sb.append("or ");\n            } else {\n                sb.append("("); // Only if we really have selected tags\n            }\n            sb.append("tag:").append(tag).append(" ");\n            i++;\n        }\n        if (i > 0) {\n            sb.append(")"); // Only if we added anything to the tag list\n        }\n        mSearchTerms = sb.toString();\n        searchCards();\n    }\n\n\n    private abstract class ListenerWithProgressBar extends CollectionTask.TaskListener {\n        @Override\n        public void public void onPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result) {\n            if (timber != null) {\n                Timber.d(timber);\n            }\n            if (result.getBoolean()) {\n void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION,             }\n                v.setTag(columns);\n            } else {\n                v = convertView;\n            }\n            bindView(position, v);\n            return v;\n        }\n\n\n        private void bindView(final int position, final View v) {\n            // Draw the content in the columns\n            View[] columns = (View[]) v.getTag();\n            final Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(position);\n            for (int i = 0; i < mToIds.length; i++) {\n                TextView col = (TextView) columns[i];\n                // set font for column\n                setFont(col);\n                // set text for column\n                col.setText(card.get(mFromKeys[i]));\n            }\n            // set card\'s background color\n            final int backgroundColor = Themes.getColorFromAttr(CardBrowser.this, getColor(card));\n            v.setBackgroundColor(backgroundColor);\n            // setup checkbox to change color in multi-select mode\n            final CheckBox checkBox = (CheckBox) v.findViewById(R.id.card_checkbox);\n            // if in multi-select mode, be sure to show the checkboxes\n            if(mInMultiSelectMode) {\n      checkBox.setChecked(false);\n                }\n                // this prevents checkboxes from showing an animation from selected -> unselected when\n                // checkbox was selected, checkBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);\n            }\n            // change bg color on check changed\n            checkBox.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n                @Override\n                public void onClick(View view) {\n                    onCheck(position, v);\n                }\n            });\n        }\n\n        private void setFont(TextView v) {\n            // Set }\n            // do nothing when pref is 100% and apply scaling only once\n            if (mFontSizeScalePcent != 100 && Math.abs(mOriginalTextSize - currentSize) < 0.1) {\n                // getTextSize returns value in absolute PX so use that in the setter\n                v.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_PX, mOriginalTextSize * (mFontSizeScalePcent / 100.0f));\n            }\n\n            if (mCustomTypeface != null) {\n                v.setTypeface(mCustomTypeface);\n            }\n        }\n\n        /**\n         * Get the background color of items in the card list based on String> cardProperties) {\n            boolean suspended = "True".equals(cardProperties.get(SUSPENDED));\n            int flag = getFlagOrDefault(cardProperties, 0);\n            boolean marked = }\n\n\n        public void setFromMapping(String[] from) {\n            mFromKeys = from;\n            notifyDataSetChanged();\n        }\n\n\n        public String[] getFromMapping() {\n void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. bar if scrolling to given position requires rendering of the question / answer\n            int lastVisibleItem = firstVisibleItem + visibleItemCount;\n            int size = getCardCount();\n            if ((size > 0) && (firstVisibleItem < size) && ((lastVisibleItem - 1) < size)) {\n                String firstAns = getCards().get(firstVisibleItem).get(ANSWER);\n                // Note: max value   CollectionTask newTask = new CollectionTask(type, listener, sLatestInstance);\n        newTask.execute(params);\n        return newTask;\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * Block the current thread until the currently running CollectionTask instance (if any) has finished.\n     */\n    public static void waitToFinish() {\n        waitToFinish(null);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Block the current thread until the currently running CollectionTask instance (if any) has finished.\n     * @param timeout timeout in seconds\n     * @return whether or not the previous task was successful or not\n     */\n    public static boolean waitToFinish(Integer timeout) {\n        try {\n            if ((sLatestInstance != null) && (sLatestInstance.getStatus() != AsyncTask.Status.FINISHED)) {\n                Timber.d("CollectionTask: waiting for task %d to finish...", sLatestInstance.mType);\n                if (timeout != null) {\n                    sLatestInstance.get(timeout, TimeUnit.SECONDS);\n                } else {\n                    sLatestInstance.get();\n                }\n\n            }\n            return true;\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "Exception waiting for task to finish");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n\n    public static void cancelTask() {\n        //cancel the current task\n        try {\n            if sLatestInstance.mType);\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n\n\n    public static void cancelTask(int taskType) {\n        // cancel the current doInBackground(TaskData... params) {\n        super.doInBackground(params);\n        // Wait for previous thread (if any) to finish before continuing\n        if (mPreviousTask != null && mPreviousTask.getStatus() != AsyncTask.Status.FINISHED) {\n            Timber.d("Waiting for %d to finish before starting %d", mPreviousTask.mType, mType);\n            try {\n                mPreviousTask.get();\n                Timber.d("Finished waiting for %d to finish. Status= %s", mPreviousTask.mType, mPreviousTask.getStatus());\n            } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n                // We have been interrupted, return immediately.\n                Timber.d(e, "interrupted while waiting for previous task: %d", mPreviousTask.mType);\n                return null;\n            } catch (ExecutionException e) {\n                // Ignore failures in the previous task.\n                Timber.e(e, "previously running task failed with exception: %d", mPreviousTask.mType);\n            } catch (CancellationException e) {\n                // Ignore cancellation of previous task\n                Timber.d(e, "previously running task was cancelled: %d", mPreviousTask.mType);\n            }\n        }\n        sLatestInstance = this;\n        mContext = AnkiDroidApp.getInstance().getApplicationContext();\n\n        // Skip the task if the collection cannot be opened\n        if (mType    return null;\n        }\n        // Actually execute the task now that we are at the front of the queue.\n        switch (mType) {\n            case TASK_TYPE_LOAD_DECK_COUNTS:\n                return doInBackgroundLoadDeckCounts(params);\n\n            case TASK_TYPE_SAVE_COLLECTION:\n                return doInBackgroundSaveCollection(params);\n\n            case TASK_TYPE_ANSWER_CARD:\n                return doInBackgroundAnswerCard(params);\n\n            case TASK_TYPE_ADD_NOTE:\n                return doInBackgroundAddNote(params);\n\n            case TASK_TYPE_UPDATE_NOTE:\n             return doInBackgroundCheckDatabase(params);\n\n            case TASK_TYPE_REPAIR_DECK:\n                return doInBackgroundRepairDeck(params);\n\n            case Timber.d("doInBackgroundAddNote");\n        Note note = params[0].getNote();\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        try {\n            DB db = col.getDb();\n            db.getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                publishProgress(new TaskData(col.addNote(note)));\n                db.getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                db.getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundAddNote - RuntimeException on adding note");\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundAddNote");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        return new TaskData(true);\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundUpdateNote(TaskData[] params) {\n        Timber.d("doInBackgroundUpdateNote");\n        // Save the note\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        Card editCard = params[0].getCard();\n        Note editNote = editCard.note();\n        boolean fromReviewer = params[0].getBoolean();\n\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                // TODO: undo integration\n                editNote.flush();\n                // flush card too, in case, did has been changed\n                editCard.flush();\n                if (fromReviewer) {\n                    Card newCard;\n                    if (col.getDecks().active().contains(editCard.getDid())) {\n                        newCard = editCard;\n                        newCard.load();\n                        // reload qa-cache\n                        newCard.q(true);\n                    } else {\n                        newCard = sched.getCard();\n                    }\n                    publishProgress(new TaskData(newCard));\n                } else {\n                    publishProgress(new TaskData(editCard, editNote.stringTags()));\n                }\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundUpdateNote - RuntimeException on updating note");\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundUpdateNote");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        return new TaskData(true);\n    }\n\n    // same as doInBackgroundUpdateNote but for multiple notes\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundUpdateNotes(TaskData[] params) {\n        Timber.d("doInBackgroundUpdateNotes");\n        // Save the note\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        Object[] data = params[0].getObjArray();\n        Card[] cards = (Card[]) data[0];\n\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                for (Card card : cards) {\n                    Note note = card.note();\n                    // TODO: undo integration\n                    note.flush();\n                    // flush card too, in case, did has been changed\n                    card.flush();\n                    publishProgress(new TaskData(card, note.stringTags()));\n                }\n\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundUpdateNote - RuntimeException on updating note");\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundUpdateNote");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        return new TaskData(true);\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundAnswerCard(TaskData... params) {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        Card oldCard = params[0].getCard();\n        int ease = params[0].getInt();\n        Card newCard = null;\n        Timber.i(oldCard != null ? "Answering card" : "Obtaining card");\n        try {\n            DB db = col.getDb();\n            db.getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                if (oldCard != null) {\n                    Timber.i("Answering card %d", oldCard.getId());\n                    sched.answerCard(oldCard, ease);\n                }\n                newCard = sched.getCard();\n                if (newCard != null) {\n                    // render cards before locking database\n                    newCard._getQA(true);\n                }\n                publishProgress(new TaskData(newCard));\n                db.getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                db.getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundAnswerCard - RuntimeException on answering card");\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundAnswerCard");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        return new TaskData(true);\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundLoadDeckCounts(TaskData... params) {\n        Timber.d("doInBackgroundLoadDeckCounts");\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        try {\n            // Get due tree\n            Object[] o = new Object[] {col.getSched().deckDueTree(this)};\n            return new TaskData(o);\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundLoadDeckCounts - error");\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundSaveCollection(TaskData... params) {\n        Timber.d("doInBackgroundSaveCollection");\n        Collection col = "Error on saving deck in background");\n            }\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundDismissNote(TaskData... params) {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        Object[] data = params[0].getObjArray();\n        Card card = (Card) data[0];\n        Collection.DismissType type = (Collection.DismissType) data[1];\n        Note note = card.note();\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                sched.deferReset();\n                switch (type) {\n                    case BURY_CARD:\n                        // collect undo information\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { col.getDirty(), note.cards(), card.getId() });\n                        // then bury\n                        sched.buryCards(new long[] { card.getId() });\n                        break;\n                    case BURY_NOTE:\n                        // collect undo information\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { col.getDirty(), note.cards(), card.getId() });\n                        // then bury\n                        sched.buryNote(note.getId());\n                        break;\n                    case SUSPEND_CARD:\n                        // collect undo information\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { card });\n                        // suspend card\n                        if (card.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED) {\n                            sched.unsuspendCards(new long[] { card.getId() });\n                        } else {\n                            sched.suspendCards(new long[] { card.getId() });\n                        }\n                        break;\n                    case SUSPEND_NOTE: {\n                        // collect undo information\n                        ArrayList<Card> cards = note.cards();\n                        long[] cids = new long[cards.size()];\n                        for (int i = 0; i < cards.size(); i++) {\n                            cids[i] = cards.get(i).getId();\n                        }\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { cards, card.getId() });\n                        // suspend note\n                        sched.suspendCards(cids);\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case DELETE_NOTE: {\n                        // collect undo information\n                        ArrayList<Card> allCs = note.cards();\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { note, allCs, card.getId() });\n                        // delete note\n                        col.remNotes(new long[] { note.getId() });\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                // With sHadCardQueue set, getCard() resets the scheduler prior to getting the next card\n                publishProgress(new TaskData(col.getSched().getCard(), 0));\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundDismissNote - RuntimeException on dismissing note, dismiss type %s", type);\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundDismissNote");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        return new TaskData(true);\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundDismissNotes(TaskData... params) {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        Object[] data = params[0].getObjArray();\n        long[] cardIds = (long[]) data[0];\n        // query cards\n        Card[] cards = new Card[cardIds.length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < cardIds.length; i++) {\n            cards[i] = col.getCard(cardIds[i]);\n        }\n\n        Collection.DismissType type = (Collection.DismissType) data[1];\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                switch (type) {\n                    case SUSPEND_CARD_MULTI: {\n                        // collect undo information\n                        long[] cids = new long[cards.length];\n                        boolean[] originalSuspended = new boolean[cards.length];\n                        boolean hasUnsuspended = false;\n                        for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {\n                            Card card = cards[i];\n                            cids[i] = card.getId();\n                            if (card.getQueue() != Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED) {\n                                hasUnsuspended = true;\n                                originalSuspended[i] = false;\n                            } else {\n                                originalSuspended[i] = true;\n                            }\n                        }\n\n                        // if at least one card is unsuspended -> suspend all\n                        // otherwise unsuspend all\n                        if (hasUnsuspended) {\n                            sched.suspendCards(cids);\n                        } else {\n                            sched.unsuspendCards(cids);\n                        }\n\n                        // mark undo for all at once\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {cards, originalSuspended});\n\n                        // reload cards because they\'ll be passed back to caller\n                        for (Card c : cards) {\n                            c.load();\n                        }\n\n                        sched.deferReset();\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case FLAG: {\n                        int flag = (Integer) data[2];\n                        col.setUserFlag(flag, cardIds);\n                        for (Card c : cards) {\n                            c.load();\n                        }\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case MARK_NOTE_MULTI: {\n                        Set<Note> notes = CardUtils.getNotes(Arrays.asList(cards));\n                        // collect undo information\n                        List<Note> originalMarked = new ArrayList<>();\n                        List<Note> originalUnmarked = new ArrayList<>();\n\n                        for (Note n : notes) {\n                            if (n.hasTag("marked"))\n                                originalMarked.add(n);\n                            else\n                                originalUnmarked.add(n);\n                        }\n\n                        CardUtils.markAll(new ArrayList<>(notes), !originalUnmarked.isEmpty());\n\n                        // mark undo for all at once\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {originalMarked, originalUnmarked});\n\n                        // reload cards because they\'ll be passed back to caller\n                        for (Card c : cards) {\n                            c.load();\n                        }\n\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case DELETE_NOTE_MULTI: {\n                        // list of all ids to pass to remNotes method.\n                        // Need Set (-> unique) so we don\'t pass duplicates to col.remNotes()\n                        Set<Note> notes = CardUtils.getNotes(Arrays.asList(cards));\n                        List<Card> allCards = CardUtils.getAllCards(notes);\n                        // delete note\n                        long[] uniqueNoteIds = new long[notes.size()];\n                        Note[] notesArr = notes.toArray(new Note[notes.size()]);\n                        int count = 0;\n                        for (Note note : notes) {\n                            uniqueNoteIds[count] = note.getId();\n                            count++;\n                        }\n\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {notesArr, allCards});\n\n                        col.remNotes(uniqueNoteIds);\n                        sched.deferReset();\n                        // pass back all cards because they can\'t be retrieved anymore by the caller (since the note is deleted)\n                        publishProgress(new TaskData(allCards.toArray(new Card[allCards.size()])));\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case CHANGE_DECK_MULTI: {\n                        long newDid = (long) data[2];\n\n                        Timber.i("Changing %d cards to deck: \'%d\'", cards.length, newDid);\n                        JSONObject deckData = col.getDecks().get(newDid);\n\n                        if (Decks.isDynamic(deckData)) {\n                            //#5932 - can\'t change to a dynamic deck. Use "Rebuild"\n                            Timber.w("Attempted to move to dynamic deck. Cancelling task.");\n                            return new TaskData(false);\n                        }\n\n                        //Confirm that the deck exists (and is not the default)\n                        try {\n                            long actualId = deckData.getLong("id");\n                            if (actualId != newDid) {\n                                Timber.w("Attempted to move to deck %d, but got %d", newDid, actualId);\n                                return new TaskData(false);\n                            }\n                        } catch (Exception e) {\n                            Timber.e(e, "failed to check deck");\n                            return new TaskData(false);\n                        }\n\n                        long[] changedCardIds = new long[cards.length];\n                        for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {\n                            changedCardIds[i] = cards[i].getId();\n                        }\n                        col.getSched().remFromDyn(changedCardIds);\n\n                        long[] originalDids = new long[cards.length];\n\n                        for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {\n                            Card card = cards[i];\n                            card.load();\n                            // save original did for undo\n                            originalDids[i] = card.getDid();\n                            // then set the card ID to the new deck\n                            card.setDid(newDid);\n                            Note note = card.note();\n                            note.flush();\n                            // flush card too, in case, did has been changed\n                            card.flush();\n                        }\n\n                        // mark undo for all at once\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {cards, originalDids});\n\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case RESCHEDULE_CARDS:\n                    case REPOSITION_CARDS:\n                    case RESET_CARDS: {\n                        // collect undo information, sensitive to memory pressure, same for all 3 cases\n                        try {\n                            Timber.d("Saving undo information of type %s on %d cards", type, cards.length);\n                            col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {deepCopyCardArray(cards)});\n                        } catch (CancellationException ce) {\n                            Timber.i(ce, "Cancelled while handling type %s, skipping undo", type);\n                        }\n                        switch (type) {\n                            case RESCHEDULE_CARDS:\n                                sched.reschedCards(cardIds, (Integer) data[2], (Integer) data[2]);\n                                break;\n                            case REPOSITION_CARDS:\n                                sched.sortCards(cardIds, (Integer) data[2], 1, false, true);\n                                break;\n                            case RESET_CARDS:\n                                sched.forgetCards(cardIds);\n                                break;\n                        }\n                        // In all cases schedule a new card so Reviewer doesn\'t sit on the old one\n                        col.reset();\n                        publishProgress(new TaskData(sched.getCard(), 0));\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundSuspendCard - RuntimeException on suspending card");\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundSuspendCard");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        // pass cards back so more actions can be performed by the caller\n        // (querying the cards again is unnecessarily expensive)\n        return new TaskData(true, cards);\n    }\n\n    private Card[] deepCopyCardArray(Card[] originals) throws CancellationException {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(AnkiDroidApp.getInstance());\n        Card[] copies = new             throw new CancellationException("Cancelled during deep copy");\n            }\n\n            // TODO: the performance-naive implementation loads from database instead of working in    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundUndo(TaskData... params) {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            Card newCard = null;\n            try {\n                long cid = col.undo();\n                if (cid == 0) {\n                    // /* card schedule change undone, reset and get\n                    // new card */\n                    Timber.d("Single card non-review change undo succeeded");\n                    col.reset();\n                    newCard = sched.getCard();\n                } else if (cid > 0) {\n                    // a review was undone,\n                     /* card review undone, set up to review that card again */\n                    Timber.d("Single card review undo succeeded");\n                    newCard = col.getCard(cid);\n                    newCard.startTimer();\n                    col.reset();\n                    col.getSched().decrementCounts(newCard);\n                    sched.deferReset();\n                } else {\n                    // cid < 0\n                    /* multi-card action undone, no action to take here */\n                    Timber.d("Multi-select undo succeeded");\n                }\n                // TODO: handle leech undoing properly\n                publishProgress(new TaskData(newCard, 0));\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundUndo - RuntimeException on undoing");\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundUndo");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        return new TaskData(true);\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundSearchCards(TaskData... params) {\n        Timber.d("doInBackgroundSearchCards");\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        String query = (String) params[0].getObjArray()[0];\n        Boolean order = (Boolean) params[0].getObjArray()[1];\n        int numCardsToRender = (int) params[0].getObjArray()[2];\n        List<Long> searchResult_ = col.findCards(query, order);\n        int resultSize = searchResult_.size();\n        List<Map<String,String>> searchResult = new ArrayList<>(resultSize);\n        Timber.d("The search found %d cards", resultSize);\n        for (Long cid: searchResult_) {\n            Map<String, String> card = new HashMap<>();\n            card.put(CardBrowser.ID, cid.toString());\n            searchResult.add(card);\n        }\n        // Render the first few items\n        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(numCardsToRender, searchResult.size()); i++) {\n            Card c = }\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundRenderBrowserQA(TaskData... params) {\n        //TODO: Convert this to accept the following to make thread-safe:\n        //(Range<Position>, Function<Position, BrowserCard>)\n        Timber.d("doInBackgroundRenderBrowserQA");\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = (List<Map<String, String>>) params[0].getObjArray()[0];\n        Integer startPos = (Integer) params[0].getObjArray()[1];\n        Integer n = (Integer) params[0].getObjArray()[2];\n\n        List<Long> invalidCardIds = new ArrayList<>();\n        // for each specified card in the browser list\n        for (int i = startPos; i < startPos + n; i++) {\n            // Stop if cancelled\n            if (isCancelled()) {\n                Timber.d("doInBackgroundRenderBrowserQA was aborted");\n                return null;\n            }\n            if (i < 0 || i >= cards.size()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card;\n            try {\n                card = cards.get(i);\n            }\n            catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException e) {\n                //even though we test against card.size() above, there\'s still a race condition\n                //We might be able to optimise this to return here. Logically if we\'re past the end of the collection,\n                //we won\'t reach any more cards.\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (card.get("answer") != null) {\n                //We\'ve already rendered the answer, we don\'t need to do it again.\n                continue;\n            }\n            // Extract card item\n            Card c;\n            String maybeCardId = card.get("id");\n            if (maybeCardId == null) {\n                Timber.w("CardId was null, skipping");\n                continue;\n            }\n            Long cardId;\n            try {\n                cardId = Long.parseLong(maybeCardId);\n            } catch (Exception e) {\n                Timber.e("Unable to parse CardId: %s. Unable to remove card", maybeCardId);\n                continue;\n            }\n            try {\n                c = col.getCard(cardId);\n            } catch (Exception e) {\n                //#5891 - card can be inconsistent between the deck browser screen and the collection.\n                //Realistically, we can skip any exception as it\'s a rendering task which should not kill the\n                //process\n                Timber.e(e, "Could not process card \'%s\' - skipping and removing from sight", maybeCardId);\n                invalidCardIds.add(cardId);\n                continue;\n            }\n            // Update item\n            CardBrowser.updateSearchItemQA(mContext, card, c, col);\n            float progress = (float) i / n * 100;\n            publishProgress(new TaskData((int) progress));\n        }\n        return new TaskData(new Object[] { cards, invalidCardIds });\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundCheckDatabase(TaskData... private void onSearch() {\n        mSearchTerms = mSearchView.getQuery().toString();\n        if (mSearchTerms.length() == 0) {\n            mSearchView.setQueryHint(getResources().getString(R.string.downloaddeck_search));\n        }\n        searchCards();\n    }\n\n    private long[] getSelectedCardIds() {\n        //copy to array to ensure threadsafe iteration\n        Integer[] checkedPositions = mCheckedCardPositions.toArray(new Integer[0]);\n        //copy the reference: the list can be replaced by an async operation while we iterate\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = getCards();\n        long[] ids = new long[checkedPositions.length];\n        int count = 0;\n        for (int cardPosition : checkedPositions) {\n            //#6112: A checked position refers to the card list which was displayed when the card was checked.\n            //If the list was reloaded (or cleared) in the meantime, the position may no longer be valid.\n            if (cardPosition < 0 || cardPosition >= cards.size()) {\n                Timber.w("Attempted to access card at invalid position: %d (%d cards)", cardPosition, cards.size());\n                continue;\n            }\n            String cardId = cards.get(cardPosition).get(ID);\n            if (cardId == null) {\n                Timber.w("No card id at position: %d", cardPosition);\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids[count++] = Long.parseLong(cardId);\n        }\n        //the array may have been oversized if some positions were stale\n        if (count != ids.length) {\n            ids = Arrays.copyOf(ids, count);\n        }\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @return Whether the currently selected cards all belong to one (and only one) note.\n     * Used to determine whether the note can be edited: editing only affects a single note (#6112),\n     * so we must not offer the option when cards of multiple notes are selected.\n     */\n    private boolean hasSelectedSingleNoteId() {\n        long[] selectedCardIds = getSelectedCardIds();\n        if (selectedCardIds.length == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (selectedCardIds.length == 1) {\n            //one card is always exactly one note: no need to hit the database\n            return true;\n        }\n        //Heuristic to skip a potentially large query\n        if (selectedCardIds.length > 50) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (!colIsOpen()) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        try {\n            //Note: the "note" column of the browser contains the note type name, not the note id,\n            //so the selected note ids have to be obtained from the collection.\n            int noteCount = getCol().getDb().queryScalar(\n                    "select count(distinct nid) from cards where id in " + Utils.ids2str(selectedCardIds));\n            return noteCount == 1;\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Timber.w(e, "Failed to determine the number of selected notes");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    void changeDeck(int closeCardBrowser(DeckPicker.RESULT_DB_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if (requestCode == EDIT_CARD && resultCode != RESULT_CANCELED) {\n            Timber.i("CardBrowser:: CardBrowser: Saving card...");\n            CollectionTask.launchCollectionTask(CollectionTask.TASK_TYPE_UPDATE_NOTE, mUpdateCardHandler,\n                    new CollectionTask.TaskData(sCardBrowserCard, false));\n        } else if (requestCode == ADD_NOTE && resultCode == RESULT_OK) {\n            if (mSearchView != null) {\n                mSearchTerms = mSearchView.getQuery().toString();\n                searchCards();\n            } else {\n                Timber.w("Note was added from browser and on return mSearchView == null");\n            }\n\n        }\n\n        if (requestCode == EDIT_CARD &&  data!=null && data.hasExtra("reloadRequired")) {\n            // if reloadRequired flag was sent from note editor then reload card list\n            searchCards();\n            // in use by reviewer?\n            if (getReviewerCardId() == mCurrentCardId) {\n                mReloadRequired = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        invalidateOptionsMenu();    // maybe the availability of undo changed\n    }\n\n\n    // We spawn CollectionTasks that may create memory pressure, this transmits it so polling isCancelled sees the pressure\n    @Override\n    public void onTrimMemory(int @Override\n    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Bundle savedInstanceState) {\n        super.onRestoreInstanceState(savedInstanceState);\n        mSearchTerms = savedInstanceState.getString("mSearchTerms");\n        searchCards();\n    }\n\n    private void searchCards() {\n        // cancel the previous search & render tasks if still running\n        CollectionTask.cancelTask(CollectionTask.TASK_TYPE_SEARCH_CARDS);\n        CollectionTask.cancelTask(CollectionTask.TASK_TYPE_RENDER_BROWSER_QA);\n        String searchText;\n        if (mSearchTerms == null) {\n            mSearchTerms = "";\n        }\n        if (!"".equals(mSearchTerms) && (mSearchView != null)) {\n            mSearchView.setQuery(mSearchTerms, false);\n            mSearchItem.expandActionView();\n        }\n        if (mSearchTerms.contains("deck:")) {\n            searchText = mSearchTerms;\n        } else {\n            searchText = mRestrictOnDeck + mSearchTerms;\n        }\n        if (colIsOpen() && mCardsAdapter!= null) {\n            // #6112: the current selection is stored as positions in the card list which is about to be\n            // discarded. Remove it, otherwise we either operate on the wrong cards, or crash when\n            // accessing a position which no longer exists.\n            invalidateSelection();\n            // clear the existing card list\n            mCards = new ArrayList<Map<String, String>>();\n            mCardsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();\n            //  estimate maximum number of cards that could be void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view.    private void bindView(final int position, final View v) {\n            // Draw the content in the columns\n            View[] columns = (View[]) v.getTag();\n            final Map<String, String>          final CheckBox checkBox = (CheckBox) v.findViewById(R.id.card_checkbox);\n            // if in multi-select mode, be sure to show the checkboxes\n            if(mInMultiSelectMode) {\n private void onSearch() {\n        mSearchTerms = mSearchView.getQuery().toString();\n        if (mSearchTerms.length() == 0) {\n            mSearchView.setQueryHint(getResources().getString(R.string.downloaddeck_search));\n        }\n        searchCards();\n    }\n\n    private long[] getSelectedCardIds() {\n        //copy to array to ensure threadsafe iteration\n        Integer[] checkedPositions = mCheckedCardPositions.toArray(new Integer[0]);\n        //copy the reference: the list can be replaced by an async operation while we iterate\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = getCards();\n        long[] ids = new long[checkedPositions.length];\n        int count = 0;\n        for (int cardPosition : checkedPositions) {\n            //#6112: A checked position refers to the card list which was displayed when the card was checked.\n            //If the list was reloaded (or cleared) in the meantime, the position may no longer be valid.\n            if (cardPosition < 0 || cardPosition >= cards.size()) {\n                Timber.w("Attempted to access card at invalid position: %d (%d cards)", cardPosition, cards.size());\n                continue;\n            }\n            String cardId = cards.get(cardPosition).get(ID);\n            if (cardId == null) {\n                Timber.w("No card id at position: %d", cardPosition);\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids[count++] = Long.parseLong(cardId);\n        }\n        //the array may have been oversized if some positions were stale\n        if (count != ids.length) {\n            ids = Arrays.copyOf(ids, count);\n        }\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @return Whether the currently selected cards all belong to one (and only one) note.\n     * Used to determine whether the note can be edited: editing only affects a single note (#6112),\n     * so we must not offer the option when cards of multiple notes are selected.\n     */\n    private boolean hasSelectedSingleNoteId() {\n        long[] selectedCardIds = getSelectedCardIds();\n        if (selectedCardIds.length == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (selectedCardIds.length == 1) {\n            //one card is always exactly one note: no need to hit the database\n            return true;\n        }\n        //Heuristic to skip a potentially large query\n        if (selectedCardIds.length > 50) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (!colIsOpen()) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        try {\n            //Note: the "note" column of the browser contains the note type name, not the note id,\n            //so the selected note ids have to be obtained from the collection.\n            int noteCount = getCol().getDb().queryScalar(\n                    "select count(distinct nid) from cards where id in " + Utils.ids2str(selectedCardIds));\n            return noteCount == 1;\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Timber.w(e, "Failed to determine the number of selected notes");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    void changeDeck(int deckPosition) {\n        long[] ids = getSelectedCardIds();\n\n        JSONObject selectedDeck = getValidDecksForChangeDeck().get(deckPosition);\n\n        try {\n            //#5932 - can\'t be dynamic\n            if (Decks.isDynamic(selectedDeck)) {\n                Timber.w("Attempted to change cards to dynamic deck. Cancelling operation.");\n                displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n                return;\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n            Timber.e(e);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        mNewDid = selectedDeck.getLong(ID);\n\n        Timber.i("Changing selected cards to deck: %d", mNewDid);\n\n        if (ids.length == 0) {\n            endMultiSelectMode();\n            mCardsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (CardUtils.isIn(ids, getReviewerCardId())) {\n            mReloadRequired = true;\n        }\n\n        executeChangeCollectionTask(ids, mNewDid);\n    }\n\n\n    private void displayCouldNotChangeDeck() {\n        UIUtils.showThemedToast(this, private void filterByTag(List<String> selectedTags, int option) {\n        //TODO: Duplication between here and CustomStudyDialog:customStudyFromTags\n        mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n
